question: Identify the antonym of "Taciturn"
solution:
The correct answer is: **Talkative**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Taciturn"** means someone who is reserved or uncommunicative in speech; saying little. (मौनी, कम बोलने वाला)
 
 
• **Example:** He is known to be taciturn during meetings, rarely contributing to discussions.
 
 
 
• **"Talkative"** refers to someone who speaks a lot or enjoys having conversations. (बातूनी, अधिक बोलने वाला)
 
 
• **Example:** She is extremely talkative and loves sharing stories with everyone she meets.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Taciturn'** is **'Talkative.'**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Talkative**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Silent** (चुप): Not speaking or making noise.
 
 
• **Example:** The room was silent as everyone waited for the announcement.
 
 
 
• **Reserved** (संकोची): Someone who is slow to reveal emotions or opinions.
 
 
• **Example:** He was reserved at first but opened up as the conversation progressed.
 
 
 
• **Quiet** (शांत): Making little or no noise; calm.
 
 
• **Example:** She prefers quiet places to study and concentrate.
